title: RenderRecord
description: One rendered/generated video artifact (engine/SPEC.md Phase 3; M2Radar_Content_Engine_Full_Execution_Prompt_v4.md §83). Written by engine.storage.Storage.record_render() to data/renders/<run_id>-<card_id>.json and, guarded, to the render_records SQL table engine/storage.py creates. Supabase is the canonical store for storage_provider='supabase'; storage_provider='local' is the LocalStorage fallback used in development and tests.

run_id.description: engine.state run_id (SPEC §1: YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM-<6 hex>) of the run that produced this render.

script_version.description: card.script.version bound into this render — see engine/cards_v2.py's script_versions log.

storyboard_version.description: Storyboard revision bound into this render. cards_v2 does not version the storyboard separately from the card today; this module treats it as 1 unless a future card format adds explicit storyboard versioning.

render_version.description: 1-based counter of renders for this (run_id, card_id) pair; lets a card be re-rendered without overwriting an earlier reviewed export.

source_take_ids.description: Identifiers of the supplied takes used, formatted '<scene_id>#<take>' (e.g. 'S01#2'), one per storyboard scene bound to real footage. Empty array is valid for a previs-only render with no owner footage yet.

final_object_key.description: Key/path the video was stored under (Storage.put()'s return value) — a relative path for LocalStorage, a 'bucket/key' string for SupabaseStorage.

thumbnail_key.description: Key/path of a stored thumbnail image, or null when none was generated.

duration_s.description: Final rendered video duration in seconds.

edl_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact EDL JSON file rendered — the same field render.mjs's own receipt writes as edl_sha256, so a render_records row and a render.mjs receipt can be cross-checked byte-for-byte.

qa_status.description: Quality-check outcome per cards/README.md/PRODUCTION_PIPELINE.md's QA step. PENDING immediately after render.mjs produces a review export; OK/FAILED only after a human (or a documented automated check) records a verdict.

storage_provider.description: Which Storage implementation actually holds final_object_key. 'supabase' is canonical for anything meant to be reviewed by someone other than the operator's own machine; 'local' is the LocalStorage fallback.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (engine.db_util.now() format), when this record was written.
